youtube_title: Where Did Your Free 15 GB Go? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Your free Google storage is one shared 15 GB bucket: Gmail, Google Photos and Drive all count. Since 2024, WhatsApp chat backups on Android also count toward it. So it fills up, and the upgrade button appears. Fix: open Google One's storage manager, delete large files, old attachments and blurry photos, and turn off videos in WhatsApp backup. Clean first, then decide if you need to pay.
Source: Google One Help; WhatsApp Help (2024).
